requirementsImplemented.note: Inventory + classification of every dealt creative form (report table): product invariants and book allocations retained; exampleArcs/exampleLenses/memorableShapes/idiomFamilies/shellRegister/practiceVerb/groundingForm-taxonomy classified obsolete recipes; architecture instructions' ban text classified overlapping-ban debt.

Demoted from writer-visible hard requirements: the per-slot arc table, the named lens taxonomy, memorable-line formulas, idiom/shell/verb registers, grounding-form taxonomy, and the architecture instructions' embedded device bans. RENDER-ONLY demotion — no gate/critic consumed these fields (verified), so dealt state, lineage hashes, regen budgets, and BR6/BR7 are byte-stable.

Retained decisions express as compact outcomes: exact example count, entry/outcome variety, anchor budget (2-3), friction outcome, surfaces-must-differ, memorable no-shared-mold, grounding safety rules, architecture shape outcomes. The CONTENT DEVICES deal is the single ban owner.

src/critics/cloneDetection.ts: normalized hook-exact, cross-chapter memorable-line-exact, >=12-word shared n-grams, scenario shingle-Jaccard >=0.82, opener stem families, taxonomy wording. Thresholds calibrated on clean fixtures (clean varied book => zero findings); the fixture's own first draft was flagged for real shared boilerplate — a live calibration proof.

13 passive features (opener function, setting category, actor register, source origin/form from the IMP-03 plan, tension source, discovery/resolution/rescue timing, prop dependence, narrative container, before/after shape, practice action family, memorable-line pattern) with honest unknown/none values; a structure-preserving noun swap extracts the identical vector (tested).

First-write ledger: records at every commit via post-commit hooks in authorRun+authorRepair; firstWrite=true only for author-initial generation-1; repaired versions recorded as diagnosis rows and excluded from the first-write denominator (firstWriteRecords). Diversity is never inferred from accepted final chapters; the CLI report labels its clone scan as current-bytes.

Telemetry hidden from the writer: no render path (import audit — consumers are the CLI verb and the two post-commit hooks); default configuration is shadow (DEFAULT_DIVERSITY_CONFIG all-shadow); recording is OPT-IN via CHAPTERFLOW_DIVERSITY_LEDGER_ROOT (zero suite writes).

Activation contract: validateDiversityConfig requires non-empty evidenceRef + selectionReason + frozen thresholds to activate; configVersion + sha256 hash; an INVALID config degrades to shadow while RETURNING the error list (fail-safe, not silent). Tested: ad hoc activation rejected; valid evidenced activation accepted.

maxActiveConstraintsPerChapter validated <=2; selectionReason required on any active check; the label->outcome phrasing responsibility is documented in diversityConfig so an active render can never expose a taxonomy label. No active render path exists in v1 (all-shadow), so exposure is structurally zero.

Exact-clone separated from broad similarity: exact-clone is the ONLY class the validator accepts for blocking; near-clone and feature-concentration are rejected at blocking in v1 (shadow-first permanently until held-out calibration). Exact-clone itself still SHIPS shadow — promotion is a config change with evidence, never a code default.

Anti-taxonomy leakage: CARD_FORBIDDEN_LABELS (demoted set — pinned absent from renders in stier-levers/stier2-levers) + PROSE_FORBIDDEN_LABELS (distinctive-only forms; single dictionary words excluded as an FP guard) + taxonomyLeaksInProse riding every ledger record and the clone scan.

Config hash (recursive key-sorted canonical JSON) + feature schema version stamped on every ledger record; when IMP-10 evidence is opted-in the record also rides the attempt's evidence objects (recordAttemptObject 'diversity-features'). Bakeoff evidence integration is the IMP-11 consumer.

unresolvedRisks: NO diversity-improvement claim is made: the de-recipe removes writer-visible procedure and the telemetry measures outcomes, but whether first-write quality/diversity improves is exactly the IMP-11 bakeoff question (F-008's hypothesis). If first-write quality drops, the compact outcomes can be selectively re-expanded on evidence — the deals still allocate everything needed to re-render.
Feature classifiers are honest regex heuristics; their real-corpus distributions need one calibration pass before any concentration threshold is trusted (IMP-11).
The prose taxonomy scan is distinctive-labels-only by design; a single-word pool label reproduced in prose (e.g. 'walkthrough') is undetected — accepted FP/FN tradeoff, documented.

The first-write ledger records only where CHAPTERFLOW_DIVERSITY_LEDGER_ROOT is set (opt-in, IMP-10 pattern) — production/bakeoff runs must set it or first-write concentration is unavailable (the CLI report says so explicitly).
dependencyAssumptions: IMP-07 consumes the de-reciped repair card (the anchor-allocation line is the only slot-level dealt constraint a patch must respect).
IMP-10 evidence attach uses recordAttemptObject('diversity-features') when the attempt has an evidence root; disabled evidence loses nothing from the ledger itself.

IMP-11 owns clone-threshold and feature-distribution calibration on held-out data and ANY activation (the config's evidenceRef points at its outputs); it sets CHAPTERFLOW_DIVERSITY_LEDGER_ROOT for bakeoff first-write measurement.
IMP-13's canary runbook may enable the ledger env in production (one line, same class as CHAPTERFLOW_EVIDENCE_ROOT).
baselineHash is the IMP-04 commit (full sha); resultHash is sha256 of the staged unified diff (code + narrative report, excluding this JSON).
